hail_day: distinct calendar date with confirmed ground observation per scope
event_group: distinct T09 group; not synonymous with observation
monthly: descriptive historical distribution; no significance claim

mrms_annual_coverage.2016-2019: unavailable; radar_positive null, not numeric zero
mrms_annual_coverage.2020: partial year from 2020-10-14; zero applies to available sampled period only
mrms_annual_coverage.2021-2025: archive coverage available; radar positive is contextual not hail-ground truth

mrms_semantics: MRMS is radar-derived context only; sampled no-signal does not prove absence of hail.
